sources.title: MAPS Wave 1 2020 Demographics
sources.methodology: MRF public demographic release. The document warns that it is half of an annual sample and marks relatively unstable (*) and highly unstable (**) estimates.
sources.universe: Weighted population represented in the public MAPS release.
capabilities: NUMBER OF DOMESTIC WORKERS LIVE ON PREMISES
NUMBER OF PEOPLE CURRENTLY LIVING IN HH
qualityNotes: Do not use as current production currency without confirming MRF licence/contract terms.
Preserve source stability flags; never hide * or ** warnings.
